description: Defines a BottomSheet UI component extending BottomSheetDialogFragment, with customizable actions, header, and display options. Includes nested classes for actions and a builder pattern for configuration.

classes.name: BottomSheet
classes.description: A bottom sheet dialog fragment with customizable header and actions, supporting a builder pattern for configuration.

classes.name: BottomSheet.Action
classes.description: Parcelable class representing an action item in the bottom sheet, including title, icon, and click behavior.

classes.name: BottomSheet.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing a set of actions to be displayed in the BottomSheet.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view hierarchy for the bottom sheet, including header and action items.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the bottom sheet behavior to be expanded when shown.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to display the bottom sheet with specified header, fragment manager, and actions.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Adds an action to the builder with a string title and icon.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Adds an action to the builder with a resource ID title and icon.
